answer: Self-incrimination bounty. Each identity's earnings vest along a 20-epoch ridge, and anyone who posts fresh signatures from two keys over one public nonce proves they share an operator; the claimant takes half of every locked balance in that cluster and the rest burns. A farm keeps its N keys on shared infrastructure, so any hired host or leaked backup can sell the whole fleet: at 10 clones holding 5,000 POA each, one leak pays 25,000. That payout climbs toward a summit as N grows, while an honest agent's single key, kept offline like a fossil in shale, gives no one anything to sell.
